description: Experimental variogram object representing spatial continuity statistics grouped by direction and lag.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the experimental variogram is calculated for.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: The attribute the experimental variogram is calculated for.

geometry.description: data (start, end, value, num_pairs) and optional per-lag attributes (e.g. weights).

allOf.description: Attributes associated with each lag (length must match lag core data length).

data.description: Binary blob reference for lag table. Columns: start, end, value, num_pairs

directions.description: Direction table (azimuth, dip, count, offset) and optional attributes. The count and offset reference slices in the lag table.

allOf.description: Attributes associated with each direction (length must match direction table length).

data.description: Binary blob reference for direction table. Columns: azimuth, dip, count, offset
